evidence_quotes.agenda: Before I go over pricing structure and estimate, do you have any question any clarification regarding the moving process in general?
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: No, ma'am, I'll tell you there's a lot of details the person's got to know and I understand where you got to get your estimate good so, that's fine. -- full credit applies per the no-concern-raised rule
evidence_quotes.save_your_ass: this is just an estimate. We only factored in a little extra time in the quote based on the details that we have discussed. Ultimately on move day, if the move goes faster than what we have expected, anticipated, then of course you pay less

top_strength: Delivered a clean, up-front quid pro quo framing and then built a fully itemized, three-stop estimate (storage unit, house, apartment) with real patience through a customer who struggled with texting photos and repeatedly needed things re-explained -- never lost the thread of a genuinely complex call.
coaching_note: Save Your Ass is still missing the commit-to-rate/experience line and the 'does that feel fair' pause, and the close has no rate-lock line -- easy adds on a call this long.
grading_note: two_layers_deep scored 15 via the no-concern-raised rule -- an informal remark mid-call about the estimate not needing to be perfect was already fully addressed in the moment and didn't need further digging.
